baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive causative سُيِّرَت, the solid mass image of الجبال, the result construction فكانت, and سراب as waterlike appearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: An externally imposed motion removes a massive fixed landmark from its stable condition, and the fa-result resolves that material certainty into visible appearance without corresponding water.

activation_trace.role: Removal or driving away makes the passive motion an imposed displacement, not ordinary travel.
The high solid mass supplies the maximum contrast with the insubstantial result.
Temporal occurrence marks the mirage as the resulting state of the moved mountains.
The shimmering waterlike appearance supplies visibility while withholding real water and mass.

changed_reading.before: The mountains are moved and become a mirage.
changed_reading.after: A paradigmatically solid landmark is forcibly displaced and reduced to a visible residue whose apparent water and apparent substance have no material counterpart.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سُيِّرَت carries caused progression, a mountain can image obstruction, and the root of سراب also carries going through land along a way.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can describe functional conversion as well as disappearance: what blocked passage is set in motion and becomes the course through which movement proceeds.

activation_trace.role: Caused going supplies directed progression through the transformed landscape.
Difficulty and prevention make the mountain function as an impediment to passage.
Going through the land on a path supplies the unexpected route-result.

changed_reading.before: The mountains vanish from the scene.
changed_reading.after: The obstructing topography is converted into a traversable course, so disappearance also performs a routing function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root inventory of سراب holds both security of self or household and the mirage, beside mountains as solid masses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The result word folds a latent image of felt security into its overt image of deceptive water, allowing the mountain's apparent guarantee of safety to become appearance only.

activation_trace.role: The solid elevated mass supplies the intuitive basis for environmental security.
Security of self, heart, or household introduces the affective value latent in the result root.
The mirage turns that felt security into a compelling but unsupported appearance.

changed_reading.before: A stable feature of the environment is removed.
changed_reading.after: The felt security attached to the world's most stable feature is exposed as contingent and potentially mirage-like.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence assembles a habitable system from bedding, fixed pegs, restorative cessation, protective covering, and livelihood. The focus then makes its most stable visible component into a mirage, so the change reaches the reliability of the whole habitat rather than one geological object.

activation_trace.role: The mountain is the solid landmark through which the habitat's stability is tested.
The root's security image lets environmental arrangement register as felt safety.
Mirage converts the apparent guarantee into unsupported appearance.
A prepared, spread bedding supplies the inhabitable ground layer.
Peg-like erection and fixity make the mountains structural stabilizers.
Rest and stillness add bodily restoration to the habitat.
Covering by a garment adds protection and concealment.
Livelihood completes the habitat as a system that sustains ordinary life.

structural_cues: 78:6-11 accumulates coordinated conditions of habitation before 78:20 reverses the solidity of one of their principal supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bedding, pegs, rest, covering, livelihood, and the security/mirage branches of سراب; I infer that their accumulation forms a felt guarantee which the focus revokes. A live narrower alternative is that only the physical landscape, not the experience of security, is in view.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports the loss of mountains.
changed_reading.after: The focus withdraws the apparent guarantee furnished by the entire habitable order: even the environment's most dependable support can become mere appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first describes an anchored and joined cosmic structure, then uses adjacent passive transformations to open the upper enclosure and displace the lower pegs. The focus is therefore a deliberate deconstruction of fastening and closure, not an isolated spectacular image.

activation_trace.role: Imposed removal performs the unfastening of the lower structure.
The high solid mass is the lower structure that loses anchoring.
Mirage is the residual appearance after structural solidity is withdrawn.
The earlier mention identifies the same mountains as massive structural elements.
The driven peg image specifies how those masses anchor the earth.
Building by joining parts supplies the complementary upper construction.
Strength and hardness characterize the built upper layers before their opening.
Opening a closure begins the dismantling immediately before the focus.
Becoming multiple doors converts a continuous enclosure into passages.

structural_cues: 78:7 and 78:12 establish lower anchoring and upper construction; 78:19-20 reverse them in two successive passive clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pegs, joined construction, strength, opening, doors, and imposed mountain removal; I infer a coordinated reversal of cosmic architecture. The live alternative is two independent end-time images without a shared structural operation.

changed_reading.before: A solid object is relocated and appears insubstantial.
changed_reading.after: The world's fasteners and closures are systematically undone: the roof becomes entrances and the anchors become only visible haze.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier real water descends in abundance and causally brings out vegetation; after the focus, drink and coolness are withheld and replaced by hot or flowing punitive matter. The mirage at the hinge is thus a counterfeit hydrology: the sign of water remains while water's cooling, nourishing, and generative functions are absent.

activation_trace.role: The mirage presents a water-sign with no real water.
The root's flowing and seeping image keeps liquid motion perceptually active in the false-water result.
Actual water supplies the material counterpart that the mirage lacks.
Pouring abundance marks real water as forceful and materially effective.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies water's productive causal effect.
Vegetation emerging from earth is the life-result missing from the mirage.
The denial of drink names the unavailable use falsely promised by a waterlike appearance.
Hot water reverses the expected cooling benefit of water.
Flowing or pouring matter preserves liquidity while reversing nourishment into punishment.

structural_cues: The explicit purpose clause in 78:15 links real water to growth, while 78:24-25 explicitly negate cooling and drinking immediately after the cosmic hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive water before the focus, waterlike mirage in it, and unusable punitive liquids after it; I infer that the focus reverses water's function while preserving its look. The live alternative is that سراب is only a conventional image of disappearance without hydrological contrast.

changed_reading.after: They become a counterfeit water-landscape at the boundary between life-giving rain and drink that cannot cool or nourish.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from deferred knowing and denied signs to exhaustive registration, the true day, and direct sight of prior action. At the center of that movement, an apparently unquestionable solid object becomes deceptive appearance. The focus therefore rehearses a transfer of certainty from present perception to disclosed and recorded reality.

activation_trace.role: The solid, elevated landmark represents maximal present sensory certainty.
Mirage separates compelling appearance from underlying actuality.
Future disclosure establishes knowing as an event that will replace present uncertainty.
Contradiction of truth supplies the human refusal that the disclosure overturns.
Visible signs are the evidence denied despite being presented.
Exhaustive enumeration removes gaps through which reality could remain hidden.
A binding written determination gives disclosed reality durable evidentiary form.
Reality fixed against falsehood names the endpoint of the epistemic reversal.
Directed sight or insight makes each person confront what had been merely reported.

structural_cues: The doubled future-knowing formula at 78:4-5 opens a sequence that ends with the true day and personal sight at 78:39-40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deferred knowledge, denied signs, complete recording, truth, sight, and the mirage contrast; I infer that the mountain's perceptual reversal models disclosure. The live alternative is a purely physical event with no comment on how certainty is established.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts a surprising change in visible geography.
changed_reading.after: The most self-evident object in present sight becomes an object lesson in sight's limits, while final knowledge rests on disclosed, recorded, and confronted reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's فكانت belongs to a timed chain: a day of judicial separation is fixed to an appointed limit, cosmic structures enter new resultant states, and the destination is already prepared as a watchpoint. Mountain-to-mirage is execution of an ordered transition rather than uncontrolled cosmic drift.

activation_trace.role: The result verb locates the mountain's new state within an occurring temporal sequence.
The passive imposed removal supplies the executed operation.
The eventful, severe day provides the temporal frame.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood gives the transition its function.
The repeated temporal predication links the appointment to the focus's result construction.
Fixing a thing to a time or limit makes the transformation scheduled.
Preparation and emplacement show that the post-transformation destination is ready in advance.

structural_cues: 78:17 announces the appointment, 78:19-20 repeat فكانت result clauses, and 78:21 closes the sequence with another كانت predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, judicial separation, repeated temporal predication, imposed motion, and a prepared watchpoint; I infer an ordered execution sequence. The live alternative is that كان only narrates states and does not imply prior configuration.

changed_reading.before: The mountain transformation is a chaotic symptom of cosmic collapse.
changed_reading.after: The transformation is a timed operation within judicial separation, moving the world through assigned states toward an already prepared outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Crowds are made to arrive, the upper boundary opens into entrances, the mountain barrier becomes a pathlike سراب, and a watchpoint stands on the route to a return-place. The landscape is not simply erased; it is reconfigured into a corridor that conducts the summoned to judgment.

activation_trace.role: Caused motion supplies directed transit through the transformed scene.
Difficulty and prevention cast the mountain as the barrier that must be removed.
A way through the land supplies the route latent in the result word.
Coming and arrival establish the movement's human endpoint.
Grouped people supply the organized traffic moving through the corridor.
The closed upper boundary widens into accessible openings.
Entrances give the opened boundary an explicit transit function.
A watch-place on a road places surveillance and destination directly on the route.
Return to a destination completes the directed journey.

structural_cues: 78:18-22 forms one uninterrupted sequence of arrival, opening, terrain conversion, watchpoint, and return-place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrivals in groups, entrances, a path-image in سراب, a road-watchpoint, and a return-place; I infer that removing the mountain enables compelled passage. The live alternative retains mirage as the sole result and treats the route vocabulary as coincidental.

changed_reading.before: The mountains disappear before the gathered people.
changed_reading.after: Their disappearance opens and constitutes the judgment corridor itself, converting obstruction into the route by which the gathered are conducted to their return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary result is mirage, not literal liquefaction. It remains anchored in سراب's flowing/seeping branch, سُيِّرَت's running motion, and the contrast between solid mountain and surrounding poured liquids; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for topography losing cohesion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A solid mountain is placed between caused running and a result root that includes liquid flow, seepage, and dripping.

activation_trace.role: Solid mass supplies the initial material phase.
Running motion supplies loss of fixed position and cohesion.
Flowing and seepage provide the analogical material result.
Earlier pouring gives the surah an explicit image of abundant downward flow.
Later flowing matter extends liquid motion across the focus boundary.

changed_reading.before: The mountain is no longer seen as solid because it becomes mirage.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the mountain's fixed mass runs out into a seeping visual field, as though solid topography had lost the cohesion that kept it elevated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it activates flock and traveling-company branches rather than the lexicalized mirage sense. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is sharpened by human groups arriving and later standing in rank; downstream prose should call it a personifying echo, not substitute it for the physical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سُيِّرَت can evoke a traveling company and سراب can evoke flocks or dispatched bands, allowing the moved mountains to echo the surah's mustered groups.

activation_trace.role: A company on the road personifies the mountain movement as collective travel.
Flocks and dispatched bands recast the result as grouped movement.
Human groups arriving supply the nearby muster with which the mountains resonate.
Alignment on a level row supplies the later ordered form of the muster.

changed_reading.before: Only people are mustered while mountains passively vanish.
changed_reading.after: The mountains themselves faintly join the muster as moving bands, so human and terrain alike are reorganized under one summons.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates جبل as innate formed nature and سير as way or condition, while the surface noun still denotes mountains. It remains focus-anchored and gains context from making and inward nature; downstream prose should frame it as an ontological analogy, not a lexical replacement for الجبال.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines the formed-nature branch of جبل, the way or state branch of سير, temporal becoming, and the mirage result.

activation_trace.role: Innate formed nature makes the mountain an image of apparently intrinsic constitution.
Way, conduct, or condition supplies reassignment of the thing's settled mode.
Becoming marks the new constitution as an occurring state.
Mirage shows that even the new visible mode need not possess enduring substance.
Making a thing into a condition supplies contextual precedent for assigned states.
Inward nature supplies the contextual counterpart to جبل's formed-nature branch.

changed_reading.before: A created object changes location and appearance.
changed_reading.after: As an ontological analogy, even what looks built into a thing's nature is only an assigned mode that can be moved into another state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the mountain-as-chief branch and transfers a cosmic event into the social domain. It remains anchored in الجبال and its removal into mirage, with context that strips possession and arranges all in a row; downstream prose should retain it only as a secondary analogy of rank losing substance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory includes chiefs likened to mountains, while imposed removal and mirage can image the collapse of elevated social standing.

activation_trace.role: Chiefs like mountains map physical elevation and mass onto social standing.
Removal or expulsion supplies the loss of established position.
Mirage makes the former elevation appear impressive but unsupported.
Exceeding limits supplies the social posture whose apparent height is undone.
Sovereignty and authority clarify what is denied to all before the Lord.
Standing upright replaces self-erected hierarchy with commanded posture.
A level row supplies the flattening counter-image to mountain-like rank.

changed_reading.before: The focus levels only physical summits.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary social analogy, it also empties mountain-like chiefs and transgressive elevation of substance before all stand under one authority.

strongest_changes: The mountain transformation became a coordinated reversal of the surah's earlier pegged and built cosmic architecture.
The mirage became counterfeit hydrology, preserving the look of water while reversing the cooling, nourishing, and generative functions of real rain.
The focus became an epistemic hinge in which present sensory certainty yields to disclosed, recorded, and directly confronted reality.
The path branch of سراب, together with arrivals, doors, a road-watchpoint, and return, turned disappearance into construction of a judgment corridor.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made 78:20 answer the creation sequence and simultaneously prepare the judgment sequence. Its four focus roots support material, spatial, affective, hydrological, epistemic, and procedural mechanisms without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The security reading depends on a form-distant branch of سراب and should remain secondary to the mirage sense.
The route reading is strongly activated by sequence and branch imagery, but سراب on the surface still most directly denotes mirage.
Flowing topography, mustered mountains, reassigned created nature, and flattened chiefs are analogical outliers, not claims that the surface syntax independently selects those senses.
The repeated كان clauses support an ordered transition, but they do not by themselves prove that every resulting state was portrayed as preexistent.
